The '''Bruanii sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], on the border with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] adjacent to [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]]. The [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] passed through this [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It was the site of the [[Mugaari]] space depot.

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cruiser [[Lulsla (MC40a light cruiser)|''Lulsla'']] was destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces while under supply in this sector.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Bruanii sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
